title: Location
paras: Plearn Talee enjoys an elevated location on Phuket’s scenic west coast, between the relaxed atmosphere of Kamala and the vibrant energy of Patong. Surrounded by tropical greenery and overlooking the Andaman Sea, the villa offers a peaceful setting while keeping the island’s popular coastal destinations within easy reach.

Kamala Beach is known for its sandy shores, calm atmosphere, local restaurants, and beachfront experiences, while Patong offers a livelier scene with an extensive choice of dining, shopping, entertainment, and nightlife. The location also provides convenient access to other beaches and attractions along Phuket’s west coast, making Plearn Talee well placed for guests who wish to experience both the quieter and more lively sides of the island.

rows.note: Nearest marina and pier for boat tours

reviews.quote: Amazing stay! The villa has everything we needed for a relaxing week with friends, from the big pool and jacuzzi to the entertainment rooms. We especially liked the sunset views from the outdoor areas.
reviews.name: Anthony P.

reviews.quote: We stayed here with our family and had such a great time. The villa is huge, the rooms are comfortable, and the ocean view from the pool is amazing. We also really enjoyed having breakfast outside and spending lazy afternoons by the pool. The staff were wonderful and made everything very easy for us.
reviews.name: James T.

reviews.quote: Beautiful villa with plenty of space for everyone. We loved the jacuzzi and the outdoor sala, especially in the evening when the weather was cooler. The kids were always in the game room, while the adults enjoyed the pool and drinks outside. The private chef was excellent too, and we had some of our best meals in Phuket here. Would definitely stay again.
reviews.name: Caroline M.

reviews.quote: The house is very well designed for a big group. We came with friends and there was enough space that nobody felt crowded, even when everyone was in the villa. Billiards, foosball and karaoke kept us entertained at night, and the pool area was our favorite during the day. Staff were friendly and helpful throughout our stay.
reviews.name: Robert K.

reviews.quote: We really like Plearn Talee, very peaceful place and the view is beautiful. The room was clean and comfortable and the swimming pool is very nice. Staff help us with everything and the food was good. We have very nice holiday here.
reviews.name: Sophie L.

reviews.quote: Our family stay was wonderful. The villa is spacious and the staff take very good care of us. We spend most of the day swimming and eating outside. The chef make very delicious Thai food, everyone was happy!
reviews.name: Maria G.
